recommendation: Consider a separately registered minimal official-game integration smoke for the sealed task-choice model, before refining features or labels solely on these exploratory metrics.
proposed_scope: Keep the crop model and remaining controller frozen. Compare a model-controlled task selector with the fixed task teacher, one new seed, one frozen opponent, both seats, four complete games total.
proposed_acceptance: Freeze model, code, seed inventory, opponent and process limits before execution. Require successful load and inference, observable model influence on task selection, complete official execution and replay, matching outcomes and process cleanup; report fertilizer opportunities, selections and actual effects separately.
stop: Stop on any error or exceeded budget, retain partial evidence without retry, and do not tune against the smoke results. Any later response to a concrete issue needs a separate registration.
limits: Four games can demonstrate an interface and observable action influence, not competitive improvement or statistical significance. If fertilizer opportunities are insufficient, explicitly report that its execution remains untested. No PPO, DAgger or large-scale RL.
